purpose: Choose Korean map label by map date from curated transitions, without confusing historical city renaming with language transcription or administrative annexation.

recordFields.defaultDisplayNameKo: Current Korean map name; mandatory and must match names[].text with language ko
recordFields.displayTimeline: Chronologically ordered name change points; empty for places with no verified historic change. Label references an existing Korean variant in names[].
recordFields.shortDescriptionKo: Screen-facing concise Korean city description, maximum 28 Unicode code points
recordFields.contextualDisplayNames: Regime/polity-specific historical names; never auto-apply based solely on date.

timelineEntry.fromDate: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive, Gregorian calendar, verified exact date
timelineEntry.fromYear: YYYY, inclusive approximate year-granularity change; not Jan 1 evidence

resolution: For a user-specified map date, select the most recent applicable displayTimeline entry.

A fromDate rule is exact on/after the Gregorian date. A fromYear rule permits year-level label selection; if an exact day is queried within its boundary year, flag the result as approximate rather than claiming a precise effective date.
The first entry's fromYear 1801 means only that the historic-name survey begins in the nineteenth century; it does not establish the city's founding date.

If displayTimeline is empty or the requested date is earlier than first covered date, return defaultDisplayNameKo with historicalAccuracy=unverified; do not silently claim it is the period's official name.
Only apply contextualDisplayNames if a grounded regime/polity relation valid at the point and date supports it; otherwise retain the normal timeline name.

Chinese style changes at 1912-01-01 are Korean editorial conventions, not Chinese city renamings. Japan uses Korean transcriptions of Japanese local readings; do not generate Sino-Korean kanji readings.
Aliases, mixed official naming, city boundary changes, and year-granularity uncertainties remain traceable in names[] and source notes.

displayText.rendererRule: Show only shortDescriptionKo and shortened note/detail for summaries; never render researchNote/researchDetail directly.
displayText.overflowRule: Even short strings need responsive wrapping or truncation in future UI; do not assume a fixed character limit alone guarantees no clipping.
displayText.retainProvenance: Original extended note/detail is preserved in researchNote/researchDetail where shortened.

caveats: Historical timelining is about label selection only; it does not create old boundary polygons or infer state affiliation from GeoNames sourceCountryCode.
This policy is staged only; no production manifest or map runtime was changed.
